_purpose: Self-protection example profile (pattern demonstrated: G6 self-protection, 2026-06-13, in the original harness). A REVIEW-tier 'self_guard' trigger guards CRITICAL harness files: an assistant Edit/Write to these requires an active run + explicit maintainer grant (scripts/grant-approval.js --action self_guard). NOT a hard freeze. Artifacts (runs/, evals/results/, backups/, project-maps/, .git/, .current-run) are intentionally EXCLUDED so normal harness operation is never blocked. REVIEW-tier = not added to check-approval-needed escalation and not in pre_tool_use_guard SECURITY_TRIGGERS; it blocks unapproved assistant writes exactly like wiki_handbook_docs. ZERO hook/script code change -- uses the existing sensitive_paths mechanism (sensitivePathHits relativizes against project_root; grant vocab is the union across all profiles). LIMITATION: the guard is tool-call-level -- sanctioned tooling that writes via node (e.g. regression --establish-baseline writing evals/baselines/) is NOT intercepted; only direct Edit/Write tool calls are. This is a demonstration profile, not the harness's own live self-protection config -- copy and adapt it for a real deployment.

sensitive_paths.note: policy/profiles/registries: global-policy, project-profiles/*, advisor/approval/skill/agent-identity registries, redaction-rules
frozen eval baselines -- direct edit = fake green
shared core: globMatch / sensitivePathHits / resolveCurrentRun / matchApproval

hard_rules_mirror: Harness self-modification (hooks/ config/ router/ evals/baselines/ + core scripts) requires an active run + explicit maintainer grant via scripts/grant-approval.js --action self_guard -- REVIEW-tier, not a freeze
Kill switch (DISABLED file / HARNESSKIT_DISABLED=1) outranks everything; no tier bypasses it
Push control never relaxed; no auto commit/push/migrate unless explicitly approved for that exact action
Artifacts (runs/, evals/results/, backups/, project-maps/) are NOT guarded -- normal harness operation runs free
stop_conditions: edit to hooks/ or config/ or evals/baselines/ or a core script without a recorded self_guard grant
self-modification that would weaken a guard, approval, redaction, or kill-switch path
secrets / real customer data appear in a tracked diff
